_readme: Hand-curated revenue splits shown on Stock Info when live feeds can't provide them (no free API publishes segment/geography revenue — only annual reports do). Add a stock: copy the RELIANCE block, use the symbol as the key, take percentages from the annual report's segment note (Ind AS 108), and set fy + source so the site can label provenance. Read fresh on every request — edits appear on page refresh, no server restart needed. products[] = revenue by product/segment, geo[] = revenue by geography; each entry { label, pct }, percentages should roughly sum to 100.
